About me

Ramiro Clemente

I’m a professional, full-time mixed-media artist and educator based in Barcelona. My work combines drawing, painting, collage, image transfer, calligraphy and expressive line to build layered images through improvisation and visual decision-making.

I’m also a Royal Talens Brand Ambassador and teach workshops and mentor artists internationally. I’m not interested in teaching you to copy my style. I want to show you the systems I use to keep working, experimenting and making stronger decisions when inspiration isn’t available.

FAQ

Do I need an art background?

No. The workshop is designed to work for curious beginners as well as experienced artists. The focus is on process, experimentation and decision-making rather than technical perfection.

What if I can’t attend live?

The sessions are recorded and this edition includes lifetime access to the recordings. For extreme time differences, rescheduling may be possible in exceptional cases.

Do I need to buy special materials?

No. Use what you already have whenever possible. A simple mix of paper, ink or pens, white acrylic, a few colours, brushes and optional collage/transfer materials is enough to participate.
